# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Rogue level 6 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Rogue
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5 chassis baseline to level 6 as
# chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice
# seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic ability/feat/
# skill posture from the level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5 fixtures,
# adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. Rogue grants no
# talent choice-slot line here (rogue talents are a level-2+ choice-list
# feature this slice deliberately does not implement — a genuinely
# open-ended talent tree, not a flat arithmetic burden; the level-6 "Special"
# column's own new rogue talent slot is likewise left unproven, mirroring the
# level-2/level-4 precedent), so no new choice= line is required beyond the
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5 baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Rogue burden surface: no check-execution
# engine, no trap DC resolution, no magic-trap disarm engine, no rogue
# talent, and no level-7+ progression. The PF1 Core Rulebook Rogue class
# table's level-6 "Special" column reads "Rogue talent, trap sense +2"
# (verified independently against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com) — Trap
# Sense's own flat magnitude genuinely rises to +2 at level 6 via the
# pre-existing level/3 formula; the sneak attack die count stays 3 (i.e.
# 3d6), unchanged from level 5 (the next die-count increase is at 7th level,
# beyond this bounded slice); the level-6 row's OTHER named entry, a second
# Rogue Talent slot, is deliberately left named-but-unproven, mirroring the
# level-2/level-4 rogue-talent precedent.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-rogue-level6
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:rogue:6
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:17
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:12
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:weapon_finesse
skill=skill:stealth:1
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:dexterity
